steps.text: Greetings!

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: Ah, it's a secret I'm afraid.
You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Enlightened Journey quest.

starting-off.speaker: Auguste
starting-off.text: Greetings! Would you like to be my number one accomplice? I mean, assistant?

starting-off.speaker: Auguste
starting-off.text: I am Auguste. I am going to be the first balloonist in all of Gielinor!

starting-off.player: Balloo-what? I thought only monks lived on Entrana.

starting-off.speaker: Auguste
starting-off.text: Well, they do... I was a monk. But I'm so sick of living on this island! I want to explore new frontiers!

starting-off.player: And go where no man has gone before?

starting-off.speaker: Auguste
starting-off.text: Maybe! That sounds good. I was thinking just over to Taverley, though.

starting-off.player: Why not take the boat then?

starting-off.speaker: Auguste
starting-off.text: Ugh! Ocean! Don't talk to me about the ocean...oh dear...I feel ill.

starting-off.player: Whoa, ok, no ocean. How exactly are you going to get off the island, then?

starting-off.speaker: Auguste
starting-off.text: I have devised a new way to travel. But I need an assistant balloonist to help me build my design.

starting-off.speaker: Auguste
starting-off.text: Are you an experienced adventurer willing to help me?

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: Wonderful! Let's get started.

steps.player: Wait, I still don't know exactly what we're doing.

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: Of course, of course, how foolish of me. Well, we are going to make a balloon.

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: Let me show you!

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: Oh, never mind then.

talking-to-auguste-a-second-time.player: How exactly do you plan to get to Taverley in that? How will it work?

talking-to-auguste-a-second-time.speaker: Auguste
talking-to-auguste-a-second-time.text: Have you noticed how ashes float above fires for long periods of time?

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: Don't you see? It's the hot air! It rises, taking the ashes with it.

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: I had this epiphany while I was at the glass blower's house. If we pump hot air into an envelope it will rise because it is lighter than the cold air around it.

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: We are going to sew a big sack and light a fire under it. Once the sack fills with hot air it will begin to rise, taking us along with it in the basket.

steps.player: You seem pretty confident about this. Have you tested it?

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: Well, no. You see, I don't have the materials here to make any test balloons.

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: That's where you come in!

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: You are going to collect materials for two test runs of the balloon.

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: You will need to get three sheets of papyrus, one ball of wool, one full sack of potatoes, and one unlit candle.

steps.player: What am I supposed to do with all of that junk?

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: When you have all of it, bring it to me and I'll explain what to do next. Any questions?

steps.player: Where do I get all this stuff?

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: You're the adventurer, you should know! Think of logical places, like, churches; they have tons of candles.

options.text: Err, no. I can't see that kind of detail.

steps.player: Err, no. I can't see that kind of detail.

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: You don't? Oh...well...it's just, they rise, you know, from the fire...Maybe you should pay more attention to things!

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: Next, add the unlit candle to the balloon structure. It will act as the heat source.

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: Once you have done that let me know and we will begin our experiment.

talking-to-him-after-the-second-experime.speaker: Auguste

talking-to-him-after-the-second-experime.speaker: Auguste
talking-to-him-after-the-second-experime.text: However, there are other sand pits around the world that will work as well; there is one in Yanille, Rellekka, and Zanaris.

talking-to-him-after-the-second-experime.speaker: Auguste
talking-to-him-after-the-second-experime.text: You can bring items back to me as you get them, while you are waiting for the tree to grow.

talking-to-him-after-the-second-experime.speaker: Auguste
talking-to-him-after-the-second-experime.text: I am going to give you a willow sapling and a basket of apples. You must plant the willow sapling at a tree patch.

talking-to-him-after-the-second-experime.speaker: Auguste

talking-to-him-after-the-second-experime.speaker: Auguste

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: Theoretically, we are ready for the maiden voyage.

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: Well, of course. With you piloting I am sure we will survive.

steps.player: WHAT!? This is your balloon! Why aren't you going to pilot it? And what do you mean 'survive'? You never said anything about me flying this bird!

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: Don't be silly. I'm not going to pilot it. We will be safe in the basket, the only thing we will lose are the logs.

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: You will pilot it, won't you?

steps.player: Fine, I will. So how do I control the balloon?

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: Wonderful! Let me explain my hypothesis on how to control a balloon.

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: The balloon needs ten normal logs for fuel. I believe the balloon will be controlled based on weight, so you must not have more than 40 kg with you.

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: Also, I seem to have lost my tinderbox...do you think you could bring one? We need it to light the fire.

steps.player: And here, I thought all the legwork was done. Fine, I'll bring a tinderbox.

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: Right! So, the balloon mechanics. Your prime direction will always be to land the balloon on the target at the end of our route.

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: I've written to some friends in Taverley who have kindly painted one on the ground there.

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: We must avoid everything, because the balloon is very fragile. Even clouds will be dangerous! But if my calculations are correct, we will be able to squeeze through some surprising spaces, if you pilot it well.

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: Those sandbags you made earlier will give the balloon a big lift when dropped, whereas adding the logs will only make it rise a little bit. But don't use them up too quickly! We have no way of replenishing them.

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: If you do run out of logs and sandbags you will not be able to go up any longer. Just make the best of it and hope we can make it to our destination without going upwards.

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: I've added two ropes, the red one is an emergency rope, it will let the hot air out of the balloon and we will drop quickly. The other rope will only drop us a little.

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: If we get into tribb...beg your pardon, trouble, in all likelihood we will crash. But do not fear! We should be fine. Just make sure you come back to Entrana so we can try again.

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: If it all goes horribly wrong, you can always bail. If we're still over Entrana, we can land quickly and try again. However, once past the island, we will crash.

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: Are you ready to go?

getting-ready-for-first-flight-failing-o.text: Crashed, off course. Ocean! Oh dear... I feel very...

getting-ready-for-first-flight-failing-o.speaker: Auguste

landing-in-taverley-talking-to-auguste-a.text: I am considering starting a balloon enterprise. People all over Gielinor will be able to travel in a new, exciting way.

landing-in-taverley-talking-to-auguste-a.speaker: Auguste
landing-in-taverley-talking-to-auguste-a.text: As my first assistant, you will always be welcome to use a balloon. You'll have to bring your own fuel, though.

landing-in-taverley-talking-to-auguste-a.speaker: Auguste
landing-in-taverley-talking-to-auguste-a.text: I will base my operations in Entrana. If you'd like to travel to new places, come see me there.

landing-in-taverley-talking-to-auguste-a.speaker: Auguste
landing-in-taverley-talking-to-auguste-a.text: Do you want to use the balloon? Just so you know, some locations require special logs and high Firemaking skills.

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: Weapons are not allowed on Entrana. I must search you first.
You are quickly searched.
If the player has contraband:

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: I'm sorry, no weapons or armour may be worn to Entrana. Come back when you have laid them down.
If the player does not have contraband:
The player takes the balloon transport system back to Entrana.

options.text: Could you tell me how to make an origami balloon?

steps.player: Could you tell me how to make an origami balloon?

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: First, use the papyrus on the ball of wool. The papyrus is folded into an origami box and the yarn will support the heat source.

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: Next, add the unlit candle to the balloon structure. It will act as the heat source.

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: Now you have an origami balloon!

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: If you use your origami balloon with any dye, you can change the colour.

steps.speaker: Auguste
steps.text: You can release the balloon and watch it float in the air, just use a tinderbox on it.

GIKiks.speaker: Auguste
GIKiks.text: You need papyrus and an unlit candle.

sNnyeN.speaker: Auguste
sNnyeN.text: You need a full sack of potatoes.

occzct.speaker: Auguste
occzct.text: You need more papyrus and a full sack of potatoes.

k3Az9D.speaker: Auguste
k3Az9D.text: You need more papyrus, a full sack of potatoes, and an unlit candle.

QVIYVX.speaker: Auguste
QVIYVX.text: What am I supposed to do with a note?? I can't make a balloon from notes!
